_comment: Voice Design auditions, freeze ONE id per character via POST /v1/text-to-voice after human pick. See docs/game/VOICE_PIPELINE.md §2.

siki.voice_description: An adult owl storyteller. Warm, precise, quietly curious. Rounded resonance, clear consonants, restrained theatricality, measured pacing. A distinctive speaking voice — not a hoot, not a celebrity imitation.

zana.voice_description: An adult dog enforcer. Compact, mid-to-low register. Direct consonants, short dry phrases, streetwise, controlled impatience with occasional unguarded warmth. Assertive, never cartoonish, clearly contrasted with a warm narrator.
